cdp.gloss: Customer Data Platform — the unified store of who your customers are.

decis.gloss: An agent choosing what to say, when, how often and on which channel — per person.

bandit.name: Bandits / RL
bandit.gloss: The maths that lets a system learn which choice wins by trying and measuring.

stories.head: Monetate Acquires Simon AI, Merging On-Site Personalization with a Composable CDP
stories.plain: Monetate is buying Simon AI to combine on-site experimentation with a unified customer profile and agentic decisioning in one platform. This matters because it collapses a common three-vendor stack — CDP, personalization engine, and journey orchestrator — into one, reshaping how martech buyers evaluate and budget for customer experience infrastructure.

stories.head: IAB Tech Lab Releases AAMP 2.1 to Bring AI Agents into Production Advertising
stories.plain: The IAB Tech Lab updated its AI Agent Management Protocol with governance controls, privacy guardrails, and integrations that let ad-buying AI agents operate in live environments. This is a standards-body move that directly affects how vendors build compliant agentic ad systems and how brands can safely deploy them without regulatory exposure.

stories.head: How to Measure Marketing When AI Controls Discovery at the Top of the Funnel
stories.plain: As AI search engines and assistants replace traditional search results pages, the old click-and-attribution model breaks. This piece explains how to update analytics to track brand demand and intent signals when an AI chatbot — not Google — is the first touchpoint, which changes both measurement tools and budget logic.

stories.head: MarTech: Stop Buying 'AI' and Start Buying Specific Capabilities
stories.plain: Greg Kihlström argues that 'AI-powered' is now a meaningless label on vendor slides and that buyers need to demand precise capability descriptions — what the system decides, optimizes, or generates — before signing contracts. Practical framing for procurement teams trying to evaluate real differences between tools in a crowded market.

stories.head: Grocery TV and Esri Partner to Add 3,500+ Behavioral Attributes to In-Store Retail Media
stories.plain: Grocery TV is layering Esri's geospatial behavioral and psychographic data across 6,700+ store screens, letting national advertisers plan in-store buys with the same audience depth as TV and digital. This pushes retail media targeting closer to the precision of online channels, which changes how brands allocate shopper-marketing budgets.

stories.head: Monetate Acquires Simon AI, Merging On-Site Personalization with Agentic CDP
stories.plain: Monetate is buying Simon AI to connect its on-site experimentation engine to a composable CDP with agentic decisioning. The deal means a single live customer profile can now drive both website personalization and full omnichannel journeys — a direct challenge to enterprise suites like Adobe and Salesforce that bundle these capabilities separately.

stories.head: IAB Tech Lab Releases AAMP 2.1 to Put AI Agents Into Production Advertising
stories.plain: The IAB Tech Lab's updated Agent Automation and Monetization Protocol adds governance controls, privacy safeguards, and integrations specifically designed to move AI agents out of pilots and into live ad buying and selling. This is an industry-standard spec change that will shape how every ad-tech vendor builds agent features going forward.

stories.head: ChatGPT Ads Adds Conversion Bidding and Stronger Measurement
stories.plain: OpenAI's ad platform now supports conversion-based bidding and measurement tools similar to Google and Meta, lowering the barrier for performance marketers to shift budget into AI-native search. This accelerates GEO as a paid channel, not just an organic one, and forces martech measurement stacks to add a new attribution path.

stories.head: How to Measure Marketing When AI Owns Discovery
stories.plain: As AI assistants replace traditional search at the top of the funnel, standard last-click and session analytics miss most of the buying signal. This piece lays out a practical framework for updating marketing measurement to capture brand demand and intent that never touches your website — critical reading for anyone buying or building analytics tools.

stories.head: Grocery TV and Esri Partner to Bring Behavioral Targeting to 6,700+ In-Store Retail Media Locations
stories.plain: Grocery TV is plugging Esri's 3,500-plus behavioral and psychographic audience attributes into its in-store screen network, letting national brands plan in-store buys on the same data logic they use for TV and digital. This matters because it signals retail media maturing into a fully data-driven channel that competes directly with digital for audience-based budget.

month.skicker: 30-day synthesis · the shape underneath the feed

themes.head: AI Agents Are Rewriting the Marketing Job
body: The dominant signal of the past 30 days is not that AI automates tasks — it is that directing AI agents is becoming the core marketing skill. From IAB Tech Lab releasing standards to make agents operable inside real ad ecosystems, to StackAdapt redesigning its DSP around autonomous workflows, the scaffolding for agent-run campaigns is arriving faster than most teams are prepared for.

The CMO-level implication is a structural one: org charts, hiring rubrics, and review processes built for human execution are already obsolete. Articles on building AI-first teams & on why current AI-review processes will fail point to the same gap — strategy must shift from managing people who use tools to directing agents that act.
ev: MarTech · IAB Tech Lab agents in advertising

themes.head: AI-Mediated Discovery Breaks Traditional Measurement
body: When ChatGPT surfaces Yelp reviews and OpenAI serves conversion-optimised ads, the moment a consumer first encounters a brand has moved inside AI interfaces that marketers do not own or fully observe. Attribution models, last-click logic, and even top-of-funnel SEO assumptions collapse when discovery is mediated by a language model rather than a search-results page.

AI shopping stats for 2026 confirm the behaviour shift is already at scale, and Onton's launch of a trustworthy product-discovery model signals that the market is building new intermediaries to fill the gap. Measurement strategy now has to account for an opaque middle layer between brand content and consumer decision — a genuine paradigm change, not a channel tweak.
ev: MarTech · Measuring when AI owns discovery

themes.head: Consolidation via CDP & Data Acquisitions
body: Monetate acquiring Simon AI to merge experience optimisation with a composable CDP is the clearest deal-level expression of a broader force: vendors are racing to own the full data-to-personalisation stack rather than sell point solutions. Elastic's collaboration with OpenAI to unlock unstructured enterprise data follows the same logic — whoever controls the data layer controls the AI output.

For buyers, this consolidation changes the procurement conversation. Evaluating a CDP or personalisation tool now means evaluating an AI capability roadmap, not just current feature parity. The Agile Brand's advice to 'stop buying AI and start buying capabilities' captures exactly the right decision frame for this moment.

themes.head: Trust Becomes a Measurable Competitive Moat
body: Multiple independent threads this month converge on the same finding: AI proliferation is eroding the perceived reliability of digital content, and brands that establish verifiable trust will capture disproportionate loyalty. The article on making trust a competitive differentiator frames it as a strategic choice, not a compliance obligation, while the piece on building an advantage AI can't copy shows that proprietary relationships & earned credibility are among the few durable edges left.

The consumer-side data reinforces this. AI's 'cognitive offloading' of decisions means consumers increasingly delegate trust judgements to the AI itself — so brands must also optimise for how AI systems perceive and represent them, not just how humans do. This is a genuinely new dimension of brand strategy.
ev: MarTech · Build advantage AI can't copy

themes.head: The Talent Gap Is the Real AI Bottleneck
body: Salesforce's field-service analysis names the talent gap explicitly, but the issue surfaces across every sector covered this month: organisations are investing in AI infrastructure faster than they are developing the human capacity to deploy it well. Freehand's $75M raise to staff AI teams for Fortune 500 supply chains is effectively a bet that the bottleneck is skilled orchestration, not the technology itself.

The practical decision this creates is about sequencing: buying more AI capability before closing the skills gap compounds the ROI problem rather than solving it. ByteBrew embedding real-time intelligence directly into developer workflows is one architectural response — reduce the human expertise required by making AI native to existing tools. Expect more 'embedded AI' design patterns as the talent constraint stays stubborn.
ev: MarTech Series · ByteBrew developer AI workflows

month.takeaway: Across every layer of the stack this month, the real transformation is not the AI itself but the cascade of decisions — about measurement, trust, talent, data ownership, and job design — that AI forces marketers to remake from first principles.
